subtitle: Agency details loaded from the backend.

invalidId.title: This agency link doesn’t look right
invalidId.description: The ID in the URL isn’t valid. Please go back to the agencies list and open an agency from there.
invalidId.tip1: Go back to the agencies list and select an agency.
invalidId.tip2: If you came from an external link, it might be incomplete or outdated.
invalidId.tip3: Avoid editing the URL manually — open details from the list instead.
invalidId.note: Tip: returning to the list is the safest way to navigate.

notFound.title: We couldn’t find this agency
notFound.description: It may have been removed, or the link is outdated.
notFound.tip1: Go back to the agencies list and try a different agency.
notFound.tip2: Refresh if the agency was created very recently.
notFound.tip3: If you bookmarked this page, the ID may no longer exist.
notFound.note: If you think this is a bug, you’ll be able to report it later.
